name: Admin User - Start New Application Happy Path
goal: Verify that an admin user can successfully start and submit a new car purchase application, following all steps in order.
constraints: Admin user; all inputs valid; no edits; preview and submit; no errors.

phases.description: User is detected as admin and selects 'Start new Application'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot presents new application flow after admin menu.

phases.description: User provides all required details in strict order.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot collects and acknowledges each field, moves to preview/submit.
Bot confirms submission and displays final workflow message.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
